findings.evidence: `pkg/executor/show_affinity.go:31` builds results by iterating `domain.GetDomain(e.Ctx()).InfoSchema().ListTablesWithSpecialAttribute(infoschemacontext.AffinityAttribute)` (`pkg/executor/show_affinity.go:45`) and appending rows without any visibility/privilege checks. Unlike other SHOW implementations that filter by `DBIsVisible` + `RequestVerification` (e.g. `pkg/executor/show.go:443`, `pkg/executor/show.go:570`), `SHOW AFFINITY` has no calls to `privilege.GetPrivilegeManager`. Planner also adds no `visitInfo` for `ast.ShowAffinity` (`pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go:3630`). Later history: no commits touch `pkg/executor/show_affinity.go` up to `upstream/master` (`git log a14f0c8..upstream/master -- pkg/executor/show_affinity.go` is empty).
findings.fix: Add privilege filtering in `fetchShowAffinity`: for each candidate (db, table), skip DBs failing `checker.DBIsVisible(activeRoles, db)` and skip tables failing `checker.RequestVerification(activeRoles, db, table, "", mysql.AllPrivMask&(^mysql.CreateTMPTablePriv))`. Optionally require a stricter global privilege (e.g. `PROCESS`/`SUPER`) before returning PD topology fields (leader/voter store IDs).
findings.impact: Information disclosure: any user can enumerate DB/table/partition names with affinity across the cluster and observe PD affinity state (leader/voter store IDs), violating expected SHOW visibility semantics and leaking topology/metadata.
findings.later_fix_evidence: No later changes up to `upstream/master`: `git log a14f0c8..upstream/master -- pkg/executor/show_affinity.go` returns empty.
findings.verify: Add tests creating multiple DBs/users/roles: ensure a user without DB/table privileges (or DB not visible) sees no rows for those objects via `SHOW AFFINITY`; if restricting topology fields, verify those columns are NULL/empty unless required privilege is granted.
findings.what: `SHOW AFFINITY` bypasses database/table privilege visibility checks and can expose affinity-enabled objects (and PD topology/state) to unprivileged users.

subject: ddl: sync affinity group for pd and support `show affinity` (#65049)
summary: This commit implements PD affinity-group lifecycle sync during DDL (create/alter/truncate/drop/database drop) and adds `SHOW AFFINITY`. One remaining High issue: the new `SHOW AFFINITY` path lists affinity tables across all schemas and exposes PD affinity state without any DB/table visibility or privilege filtering.
